scenario.request: Perform bounded maintenance on this maintained ts-shop using references/maintenance-contract.md and the existing approved sources, .bstack/project.json and .bstack/bin/bstack-check.mjs. Select HEAD as the explicit comparison base before editing. Capture passing original public pricing and checkout protection, then refactor packages/web/routes.ts to name the intermediate undiscounted total without changing public pricing or checkout behaviour. Collect and review the final diff, record a substantive evidenced no-impact assessment without cosmetic document edits, validate locally and run the standalone checker freshly in a different-root clean clone with isolated home/cache. Report exact assessment, base/source, command captures and fresh checker artifact paths, separating any failed or unverified checks. Do not repeat the goal interview or full audit, change approved acceptance or start a delivery service. Before every Node test suite verify at least 8 GB available memory, 20 GB free disk, load below 36, and at most two host-wide Node test suites including the proposed run; never kill another lane or print host process inventories.
answers: The public pricing behaviour is unchanged. Use the existing acceptance sources and comparison base.
